set.body:
Outcome: a reviewable Release B candidate whose comparative claims are tied to fixed drawings, constraints, and compute budgets.

Scope: execute the frozen benchmark against ranked splitting and tiny exhaustive references, retain all outcomes, and qualify the public designer workflow with the existing package checks.

Acceptance:
- Evaluate identical eligible contours, feature specifications, constraints, objective definitions, and budgets. Independently recompute outputs.
- Report target separation and nuisance residuals, optimality/bound status where available, infeasibility, failures, wall time, peak memory, seeds, and environment for every predefined case.
- Claim superiority only where the precommitted criterion is met; keep ties/losses. If the criterion is not met, retain the result and leave the release gate open pending an explicit scope decision. Do not change the benchmark after inspection.
- Run appropriate package regression/build checks on the exact release candidate and verify Release A defaults, training guards, numerical fixtures, and estimator gates still pass.
- Provide a complete set-level worked example and migration/reproducibility documentation. Keep natural-image usability and scientific predictive validity distinct from synthetic optimization success.
- No automatic release publication. The gate closes only when the precommitted comparative criterion, workflow acceptance, and required package checks are met; feasible subsets alone are insufficient.
set.title: Qualify subset-designer benefits on the frozen benchmark
